measurement_type: offline counterfactual measurement on recorded trajectories
provenance: No model was called, no provider request was made, no tool was executed, and no database was changed.

token_reduction.unit: one recorded Qwen agent provider request

off.tokenizer: Provider-recorded Qwen3-4B-Instruct-2507 tokenizer count from message.usage.prompt_tokens; tokenizer files are not present locally.

on.reason: Track A's official llm_agent path does not execute this project's compaction, so the recorded artifact structurally cannot contain paired compaction-ON provider usage. The VM also lacks the Qwen3 tokenizer files and a local transformers/tokenizers runtime, which would only affect a future offline re-tokenization of the counterfactual. No estimate was substituted.

token_reduction.comparison: Baseline established, reduction not measured: exact OFF/ON token reduction is unavailable because the official llm_agent artifact has no paired compaction-ON usage.

state_preservation.unit: provider-facing history prefix immediately before each recorded Qwen agent generation
state_preservation.method: Compare latest raw field value with compact_history(prefix) value; superseded read placeholders are not treated as losses when a later read remains.

eligibility.note: The recorded official trajectories contain no structured eligible/eligibility field; non-tool text containing eligibility claims is preserved unchanged.

confirmation_state.note: Confirmation markers in user/assistant text are outside tool-result compaction and remained unchanged.

loss_distribution.interpretation: Losses are distributed across 21 tasks; the highest task counts are task 99=45, task 98=42, task 23=42, and task 107=36.

compaction_rule_diagnosis.classification: whitelist omission, not a generic droppable-result classification
compaction_rule_diagnosis.rule: _ORDER_FIELDS does not include exchange_items, exchange_new_items, exchange_payment_method_id, or exchange_price_difference.
compaction_rule_diagnosis.status: known defect; not changed in this offline measurement

key_tool_result.note: The 306 losses are in non-superseded exchange results or order snapshots. The current compactor does not retain these exchange-specific fields; this is a measured preservation loss, not a decision-equivalence or causal decision-error claim.

decision_equivalence.reason: Excluded: it would require model inference.
